action.rationale: Fresh problem (dim=20) with total budget 100 and no incumbent; probing (~12% of budget) will reveal landscape structure while adding useful evaluations to the archive. Evaluations are cheap and deterministic, so the probe cost is justified to guide method choice.

In 20D the probes show only moderate funneling (fdc_spearman=0.3776) and the top-10 are spread ~uniformly (0.9806), indicating multiple basins; with 88 evals left we should hedge. A small race between TuRBO and GP-BO will identify the better 20D optimizer before committing the remaining ~64 evals.

TuRBO won the race (144,635 vs 186,325) and is now active with 0 evals in tenure and tr_length 0.8 (init), so we should let it run. With 64 evals left and stall_evals=17 driven by post-race inactivity, continuing TuRBO is the best use of budget now.
